metadata.title: Instant Messaging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enabling rapid, conversational messaging while maintaining identity clarity, behavioral boundaries, and accountability.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Instant messaging platforms, persistent chat channels, direct messaging, reactions, embeds, and bot-mediated interactions.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing trust, identity, and acceptable use in high-velocity instant messaging systems.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Instant messaging trust depends on baseline collaboration identity, boundary, and accountability guarantees.

metadata.remarks: Instant Messaging defines trust properties required for informal, rapid communication channels. This pattern addresses impersonation, harassment, authority confusion, data leakage, and misuse risks inherent in conversational messaging environments.

components.title: Instant Messaging Identity and Attribution
components.description: Ensures participants in instant messaging can be accurately identified and attributed.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through misleading display names or avatars in chat.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to misrepresent authority in messaging.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for chat participants.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Instant messaging users are authenticated and attributable.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct representation in messaging contexts.

components.title: Instant Messaging Behavioral Boundaries
components.description: Constrains inappropriate, abusive, or coercive behavior within messaging environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Social engineering and targeting through conversational data collection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to reduce misuse and harassment in messaging.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define acceptable use of instant messaging platforms.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict misuse of messaging features.

components.title: Instant Messaging Data Handling and Leakage Prevention
components.description: Reduces inadvertent or inappropriate disclosure of information shared via chat.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of sensitive data via chat messages or posted artifacts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control and monitoring for shared chat content.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls reduce inappropriate dissemination of sensitive information via instant messaging.
Adaptive restrictions apply when risky information sharing patterns are detected.

components.title: Instant Messaging Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides auditability and oversight of instant messaging interactions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of chat evidence to evade accountability.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support investigation of messaging misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Instant messaging events are defined and captured for audit.
Audit review supports accountability and misuse detection.
